purpose: Re-decompose the unchanged Jan-28 Marshall total after regional-airfield/water-air re-audit. Correct Eniwetok fighter over-credit, expose 952 AG float reconnaissance at Kwajalein/Ebeye, and carry Kyofu/Zuiun as subsets rather than additive aircraft.
authority_note: No CURRENT authority promotion. Counts are working bands/centers, not a claim that every historical inventory source used the same definition of operational aircraft.

historical_anchors.USSBS_25Jan: Roi: 20 fighters + 15 land-attack; Taroa: 50 fighters + 9 land-attack; Wotje: 9 Tenzan; Kwajalein: 952 AG 10 float reconnaissance; Eniwetok: 15 land-attack. Used as location/type anchor, not a like-for-like serviceability total.
historical_anchors.branch_delta: No Operation-RO drain and no historical 4-Dec mass carrier strike; repeated Seventh AF pressure and GALVANIC losses still apply.

theatre_total.warning: Physical, serviceable and immediately launchable are separate layers. Do not compare the 136 center directly to historical single-number sources without matching definitions.

base_layers.water_air_subset: ~1 Zuiun + 1-2 legacy float/recon within recon_search; not additive

base_layers.note: fighter/land-attack high-value target; no separate water aircraft forced into this node
separate lagoon/seaplane system; historical 25-Jan 10-float-recon anchor restored explicitly
Branch survival/dispersal leaves more than the historical 9 Tenzan assignment, but total remains bounded.
southern airfield + lagoon defense; Kyofu subset is inside fighter slots.
seaplane/lagoon infrastructure is a separate suppression target from the runway.
Corrects v002: USSBS 25-Jan anchor is 15 land-attack and no fighter unit. No free Raiden/fighter is carried here.
distributed support points, not a single invented air group.

search_contact_system.useful_long_range_search_sorties_per_day: 6-8 across the Marshall network under high alert
search_contact_system.fast_research_confirmation_sorties: 1-2 when a suspicious contact/submarine report exists
search_contact_system.effect: Submarine/DF/traffic reports narrow the arcs so limited aircraft can search probability corridors rather than the entire ocean.
limits: No airborne search radar assumed on these scouts.
US CAP/radar can break shadowing after the initial report.
A search contact is not a weapon-quality carrier strike solution without recontact/freshness.

kinsei_zero.dedicated_Marshall_combat_detachment_on_: 0 centered; 0-4 transient/evaluation aircraft possible but not credited
kinsei_zero.reason: Post-GALVANIC priority remains Shokaku/Zuikaku then Hiryu mixed groups; the already-adjudicated Bengal quality detachment consumes another small allocation. Do not spawn scarce Kinsei aircraft into every threatened shore base.
kinsei_zero.new_order_after_Central_Pacific_warning: 6-8 later-production aircraft may be ordered forward via Truk from 27-28 Jan, but ETA/acceptance is after this ledger clock and they are not counted on 28 Jan.

operational_conclusion: Total combat-serviceable center remains 136. The correction changes composition and resilience: Eniwetok is a land-attack reservoir, Ebeye/Kwaj is a real float-recon node, and 8-10 Kyofu plus 5-7 Zuiun are already inside existing fighter/recon slots. Water aviation preserves some search/local defense after runway cratering but depends on support infrastructure.
